Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the productive call last week. As discussed, we'd like to run a short technical validation and reference architecture review next week to: 

- Walk through a Redwood-to-Astra integration reference design (networking, auth, failover)
- Validate performance expectations for mixed request patterns (chat + embeddings)
- Exercise our integration test plan (latency, KV cache behavior, edge routing)

Attached is a first-pass reference architecture (redwood-astra-ref-arch-v1.pdf) and a basic checklist. Could you confirm an engineer to take the technical lead on your side and 2x 60-minute slots that work for you?

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 2026-02-10 10:00–11:00
- Tue 2026-02-10 14:00–15:00

Agenda we plan to cover: 1) Architecture walkthrough, 2) Test plan & data needs, 3) Network/security gating, 4) Next steps & integration milestones.

If there are any compliance documents or specific network diagrams you need from us before the review, let me know — happy to share.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Solutions
Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks for confirming Karthik. Attached is a short integration test plan (integration-test-plan.xlsx) and a 1-page performance profile summarizing expected qps and p50/p95 token latencies for the model variants we discussed. Quick answers to your asks:

- Sample load profile: see Tab "LoadProfile" in the test plan. Rough baseline: 40% chat (avg 75 tokens), 60% embeddings (batch size 32) at expected steady-state 120 rps for the pilot.
- Firewall/IPs: please whitelist 52.15.24.0/24, 52.15.25.0/24 for our dedicated pools; we'll create a temporary test ingress list during validation if needed.
- Security: we support mTLS for private deployments, TLS1.3 for hosted API, and KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). We'll bring a security engineer to the call if you want a deeper dive.

Action items for the session:
- Astra: provide your network diagram and any VPN details in advance
- Redwood: provide a small sample dataset and an available test endpoint with mock tokens

See you Tue 2026-02-10 14:00 PST. I'll send a calendar invite with the meet link.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Solutions
Redwood Inference

Vanessa — quick note on our prep work. Priyom and I paired on the validation checklist; main things we need from Astra before the call:

- NAT/VPN endpoint IPs and ASN for routing checks
- Sample payloads (anonymized) to run through prefix cache tests
- Expected concurrency for embeddings (per-client batching behavior)

I'll prepare two demo scenarios:
1) Cold-start chat latency (no KV cache)
2) Cached prefix + batched embeddings throughput

I'll also bring our runtime logs template so we can map fields to Astra's observability. Priyom — can you comment if we should also surface the quantization profile we recommend for the pilot?

Thanks,
